description: This file defines an interface IController in the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace, specifying methods for device or service management such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, and configuration handling.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling and managing plugin hosts, supporting persistence, deletion, reboot, environment retrieval, and configuration management.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete the specified path or resource.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieve environment variables or data for a given index.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Get or set configuration data for a specified callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clone the configuration from a base callsign to a new callsign.
